evals.prompt: Write the YouTube title and description for our hackathon demo. Project is TalkTuahBank, voice banking over a phone call. Won 1st Overall at HackUTD 2024. Devpost is devpost.com/software/talktuahbank, repo at github.com/aurelisajuan/TalkTuahBank.
evals.expected_output: Two or three title options in the '<Project> Product Demo | <what it does>' format, and a full description following the template: award line, hook, what it does, Core Features list, Devpost and source links, divider, follow line.
expectations: The title uses the 'Product Demo | ...' format and front-loads the project name.
The description opens with the real award line, then a hook, and includes the Devpost and GitHub links.
No fabricated awards or stats appear, and there are no em dashes in the body copy.

evals.prompt: I need a YouTube title and description for my demo video. The project is a CLI tool for generating test data. No awards. Read the repo for details.
evals.expected_output: A title and description that read the repo, follow the template, and drop the award line since there is no award.
expectations: It reads the repo before asking for missing facts and invents no awards.
The description drops the award line and opens with the hook.
It still produces a title in the 'Product Demo | ...' format and a Core Features list suited to a CLI tool.
